native_mechanisms: A chained line of prisoners sharpens one blank pillar mark by mark, each stroke's angle strictly carrying forward from every stroke before it (fully serial, order-sensitive state that mutates as data passes).

A flood that does not recede until every mark has passed bends wires anchored at fixed points, each wire bent by exactly the angle ground into the pillar on that pass (fixed-seed accumulators updated once per pass, never read mid-flood).

The token is the single fixed silhouette the wires throw against the sun after the flood drains and the shadows stop chittering — one strong read-once projection, per-mark work deliberately weak and discarded.
core_technique: xxHash3-style wide hashing: 64-byte stripes XORed against a fixed 256-byte secret and absorbed into 8 constant-seeded accumulators with weak 32x32 multiply plus cross-lane add, a scramble every 1024 bytes, overlapping final stripe and length-bucketed short paths, merged by 128-bit multiply-folds and finished with a single murmur3-style fmix avalanche.
